answer: Work waits on the raven until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the nadir of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the vertex is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
